title: fix(deps): hono 4.13.12 → 4.13.16 and @hono/node-server 2.1.5 → 2.1.6 — seven public advisories fail the scheduled OSV audit on main
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filing gate: ① a defect with a named producer, measured: the scheduled `Validate Dependencies` run 43549452164 (job 132308268047, step "Audit dependencies for known vulnerabilities (OSV-Scanner)") failed on `main` at 2026-11-14 03:01Z.

## What the scanner reports (public advisories, `pnpm-lock.yaml`)

| Package | Locked | Fixed in | Advisories |
|---|---|---|---|
| `@hono/node-server` | 2.1.5 | 2.1.6 | GHSA-jpvv-r467-5p4w, GHSA-qv5m-9pm6-hqp3 (CVSS 5.3 each) |
| `hono` | 4.13.12 | 4.13.16 | GHSA-3gg2-335m-rxc6 (3.4), GHSA-46wx-v44x-9hh2, GHSA-4h7h-rv7c-7m2v, GHSA-4m76-xfj5-7975, GHSA-h7mg-cq63-vhpq (5.3 each) |

That is 0 critical, 0 high, 6 medium and 1 low; all seven have a fixed version. The one existing exemption in `osv-scanner.toml` is unrelated and still valid.

## Why it matters

`hono` and `@hono/node-server` are the HTTP stack every deployment runs (`plugin-hono-server`, `adapters/hono`), and 18.4.0 ships these versions. The scheduled audit stays red until the lock moves.

## Do

- Bump both to their fixed releases (patch-level), regenerate `pnpm-lock.yaml`, run the server and REST suites, and run a dogfood boot once.
- **Do not add exemptions** to make the audit green. The fixes exist. Exempt only an advisory with no fix, with an `ignoreUntil` and an advisory link, as the ledger requires.
- Add a patch changeset for the packages that pin them.

## Reader

`domain:server` (the HTTP stack). Precedent: PR #33066 (fast-xml-parser onto its fixed release, with the OSV ledger kept clean).
